Game Overview

Two Hands of Satan is a multiplayer title where step into a gritty urban battlefield where donkeys and elephants clash in a relentless war. Armed with guns, choose your side and strategize to lead your team to victory. Experience intense first-person shooting dynamics, where precision and teamwork are your key assets in this thrilling multiplayer showdown.
